# Whitelist
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/utils/Whitelist/Whitelist.sol)

**Inherits:**
[IWhitelist](./i-whitelist.md)

**Title:**
Whitelist

Inheritable whitelist utility that delegates to a central ProtocolAccessManagerV2.

All whitelisting state is now centralized and scoped by a context (e.g. the vault itself).
Inheriting contracts must implement `_getAccessManager()`.


## Functions
### onlyWhitelisted

Ensures `account` is whitelisted in `context`, otherwise reverts.


```solidity
modifier onlyWhitelisted(address context, address account) ;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`context`|`address`|The context for which the account status is checked.|
|`account`|`address`|The account to check.|


### _getAccessManager

Returns the address of the access manager to delegate to.

Must be implemented by the inheriting contract.


```solidity
function _getAccessManager() internal view virtual returns (address);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`address`|The address of the `IProtocolAccessManagerV2` instance that owns the whitelist state.|


### isWhitelisted

Returns whether `account` may interact with `context`.


```solidity
function isWhitelisted(address context, address account) external view returns (bool);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`context`|`address`|The context the check is scoped to (usually a vault address)|
|`account`|`address`|The account to check|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`bool`|`true` if `account` is explicitly whitelisted for `context`, or if `context`'s whitelist is globally open (`isWhitelistOpen(context) == true`).|


### isWhitelistOpen

Returns whether the whitelist for `context` is globally open (every account passes).


```solidity
function isWhitelistOpen(address context) public view virtual returns (bool);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`context`|`address`|The context to check|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`bool`|True if every account is implicitly whitelisted for `context`.|


### _isWhitelistOpen

Returns true if the whitelist for a specific context is globally open


```solidity
function _isWhitelistOpen(address context) internal view returns (bool);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`context`|`address`|The context whose whitelist openness is being queried.|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`bool`|True if every account is implicitly whitelisted for `context`.|


### _isWhitelisted

Returns true if `account` is whitelisted in `context`.


```solidity
function _isWhitelisted(address context, address account) internal view returns (bool);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`context`|`address`|The context the check is scoped to.|
|`account`|`address`|The account being checked.|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`bool`|True if `account` is whitelisted (explicitly or via an open whitelist) for `context`.|


### _revertIfNotWhitelisted

Reverts with `NotWhitelisted` if `account1` is not whitelisted for `context`.


```solidity
function _revertIfNotWhitelisted(address context, address account1) internal view;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`context`|`address`|The context the check is scoped to.|
|`account1`|`address`|The account whose whitelist status must hold.|


### _revertIfNotWhitelisted

Reverts with `NotWhitelisted` if either `account1` or `account2` is not whitelisted
for `context`. Performs the check via the batch overload so the access manager is
queried once per call.


```solidity
function _revertIfNotWhitelisted(address context, address account1, address account2) internal view;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`context`|`address`|The context the check is scoped to.|
|`account1`|`address`|The first account whose whitelist status must hold.|
|`account2`|`address`|The second account whose whitelist status must hold.|


### _revertIfNotWhitelisted

Reverts with `NotWhitelisted` if any of `account1`/`account2`/`account3` is not
whitelisted for `context`. Used by FleetCommander exit paths and rounds-vault
redemptions where caller, owner and receiver must all be whitelisted.


```solidity
function _revertIfNotWhitelisted(
    address context,
    address account1,
    address account2,
    address account3
)
    internal
    view;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`context`|`address`|The context the check is scoped to.|
|`account1`|`address`|The first account whose whitelist status must hold.|
|`account2`|`address`|The second account whose whitelist status must hold.|
|`account3`|`address`|The third account whose whitelist status must hold.|


### _revertIfNotWhitelisted

Reverts with `NotWhitelisted` for the first account in `accounts` that is not
whitelisted for `context`.

Resolves to a single external batch call against the access manager, then iterates the
returned status array.

Assumes `areWhitelisted` returns a status array of identical length to the input.


```solidity
function _revertIfNotWhitelisted(address context, address[] memory accounts) internal view;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`context`|`address`|The context the check is scoped to.|
|`accounts`|`address[]`|The accounts whose whitelist status must all hold.|
